source_facts: In periods of market stress, Solactive calculates its indices following predefined and exhaustive arrangements.
Those arrangements are described in the Solactive Disruption Policy.
The Solactive Disruption Policy is incorporated by reference and available on the Solactive website.
Market stress can arise due to a variety of reasons.
Market stress generally results in inaccurate or delayed prices for one or more Index Components.
The determination of the Index may be limited or impaired at times of illiquid or fragmented markets and market stress.
render_facts: Market disruption may arise for a variety of reasons.
During market stress, Solactive calculates the Index in accordance with the predefined and exhaustive disruption arrangements described in the Solactive Disruption Policy.
The Solactive Disruption Policy is incorporated by reference into this Guideline and available on the Solactive website.
Market stress generally results in inaccurate or delayed prices for one or more Index Components.
At times of market disruption, the determination of the Index may be limited or impaired.
